mobs.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.steps: Open the console and browse the dashboard or searchable help. Copy exact command syntax; replace placeholders and omit brackets.
mobs.notes: help is an alias for mobs.help. mobs uses exact command matching when dispatching actions; typo matches only suggest.

mobs.help.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.help.steps: Open the console and browse the dashboard or searchable help. Copy exact command syntax; replace placeholders and omit brackets.
mobs.help.notes: help is an alias for mobs.help. mobs uses exact command matching when dispatching actions; typo matches only suggest.

mobs.advice.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.advice.steps: Use the dotted shortcut or give a command name after mobs.advice. Both display the same detailed guide without executing the command.
mobs.advice.notes: Each guide includes targeting, steps, examples, limits and related tools. Advice works at the main menu.

mobs.tutorial.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.tutorial.steps: Read the chapter list, choose a chapter number/name, or print the full tutorial. Examples are explanatory text, never replayed automatically.
mobs.tutorial.notes: The full tutorial is long; use the numbered chapters or the linked GitHub wiki when console history is hard to read.

mobs.find.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.find.steps: Type several ordinary words or a misspelled command name. Read the ranked suggestions, then enter the exact desired command.
mobs.find.notes: Search never executes guessed commands. Use advice on a suggested command to learn its full workflow.

mobs.usage.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.usage.steps: Supply a short command name to read its syntax and targeting summary. For a fuller guide, use mobs.advice.<command>.
mobs.usage.notes: Required arguments use angle brackets; optional arguments use square brackets. Do not type either bracket.

mobs.complete.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.complete.steps: Supply a partial command or a full command followed by a partial argument. The result is text you can copy; it does not run it.
mobs.complete.notes: Broad prefixes show command names. Item IDs/names appear after a complete item-taking command. Suggestions are capped in the printed result.

mobs.autocomplete.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.autocomplete.steps: Load a settlement, open the console and refresh. Type mobs. and use Tab. Fully enter an item-taking command to see item variants. Enter runs the typed command.
mobs.autocomplete.notes: Opening Development once loads card names for completion. Native dropdown support targets 0.8.117; mobs.complete remains available if native refresh fails. Off lasts until the mod reloads.

mobs.recent.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.recent.steps: Show the most recent successful command strings without replaying them. Choose 1 to 30 entries.
mobs.recent.notes: History clears on mod reload. An armed click command being listed does not prove that its later placement succeeded.

mobs.version.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.version.steps: Run without arguments. Read the returned mod/version/context information before reporting a problem.
mobs.version.notes: ping proves the command handler responds. is_in_game/debug_task validate context only. They do not test gameplay features or assign worker jobs.

mobs.ping.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.ping.steps: Run without arguments. Read the returned mod/version/context information before reporting a problem.
mobs.ping.notes: ping proves the command handler responds. is_in_game/debug_task validate context only. They do not test gameplay features or assign worker jobs.

mobs.is_in_game.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
mobs.is_in_game.steps: Run without arguments. Read the returned mod/version/context information before reporting a problem.
mobs.is_in_game.notes: ping proves the command handler responds. is_in_game/debug_task validate context only. They do not test gameplay features or assign worker jobs.

mobs.debug_task.steps: Run without arguments. Read the returned mod/version/context information before reporting a problem.
mobs.debug_task.notes: ping proves the command handler responds. is_in_game/debug_task validate context only. They do not test gameplay features or assign worker jobs.

mobs.regions.steps: List owned region IDs and names. Choose one for mobs.region and check the pin with mobs.status.
mobs.regions.notes: Region IDs depend on the save; item IDs cannot be used as region IDs.

mobs.map_regions.steps: List all map region IDs, including unclaimed and foreign regions, for map/claim operations.
mobs.map_regions.notes: Listing a region does not make it owned or allow ordinary resource edits there.

mobs.region.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.region.steps: Use a real ID from mobs.regions. current pins the camera region; selected pins the selected map region; auto clears a pin. No argument reports the target.
mobs.region.notes: A pin changes command targeting, not map ownership, camera position or building selection. Numeric IDs must come from your own save.

mobs.status.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.status.steps: Run without arguments to see treasury, influence and the chosen owned region with its wealth and approval.
mobs.status.notes: If no owned region can be resolved, choose one using mobs.regions and mobs.region.

mobs.treasury.target: Your player lord; no building selection required.
mobs.treasury.steps: Use add for a relative change or set for an exact final value. Read the result and mobs.status afterwards.
mobs.treasury.notes: mobs.undo restores the latest economy edit only while the value and player are unchanged.

mobs.influence.target: Your player lord; no building selection required.
mobs.influence.steps: Use add for a relative change or set for an exact final value. Read the result and mobs.status afterwards.
mobs.influence.notes: mobs.undo restores the latest economy edit only while the value and player are unchanged.

mobs.wealth.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.wealth.steps: Use add for a relative change or set for an exact final value. Read the result and mobs.status afterwards.
mobs.wealth.notes: mobs.undo restores the latest economy edit only while the value and player are unchanged.

mobs.approval.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.approval.steps: Use add for a relative change or set for an exact final value. Read the result and mobs.status afterwards.
mobs.approval.notes: Approval must end between 0 and 100 and the game may recalculate it. mobs.undo restores the latest economy edit only while the value and player are unchanged.

mobs.undo.target: Latest economy edit in this mod session.
mobs.undo.steps: Run after treasury, influence, wealth or approval edits to restore the previous value.
mobs.undo.notes: This is not universal undo. It refuses to overwrite newer simulation changes and does not restore inventory, demolished buildings or spawned resources.

mobs.items.steps: Search by display name or numeric ID. Copy a returned ID into pile, give or inventory commands. Names with spaces can be normalized, but an ID avoids ambiguity.
mobs.items.notes: The wiki lists the full EItemType enum, including recipes/internal values. mobs.items lists the deliverable subset. Enum labels are not always localized command-name aliases. Livestock use mobs.animal.

mobs.pile.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.pile.steps: Find an item with mobs.items. Run pile with its name or ID and an amount. Close the console and place the native Supplies preview. Read the delivery result.
mobs.pile.notes: Creates a NEW pile. Inventory changes only after placement succeeds. Amount is 1..10000. No preview argument or undo. Use drop to fill an existing target.

mobs.drop.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.drop.steps: Choose a deliverable item and amount, close the console and click owned storage, a Supplies pile or a construction site needing that material. No arguments shows pending status.
mobs.drop.notes: Does not create ground piles. Construction deliveries are capped to missing materials including incoming goods. Ineligible clicks leave delivery armed; check the message. No undo.

mobs.give.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.give.steps: Run with an item ID/name and per-building amount. Preview the exact selection first; remove preview to apply. Every target is checked before the first write.
mobs.give.notes: Amount is per selected building, not a shared total. give accepts storage/piles/sites. inventory_add also accepts production/housing and bypasses completed-building storage caps. Construction receives only needed materials. No undo.

mobs.inventory_add.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.inventory_add.steps: Run with an item ID/name and per-building amount. Preview the exact selection first; remove preview to apply. Every target is checked before the first write.
mobs.inventory_add.notes: Amount is per selected building, not a shared total. give accepts storage/piles/sites. inventory_add also accepts production/housing and bypasses completed-building storage caps. Construction receives only needed materials. No undo.

mobs.inventory.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.inventory.steps: Select exactly ONE owned building, reopen the console, then inspect it. inventory optionally filters goods by name or ID.
mobs.inventory.notes: Building inventory is local storage, not the total regional stock. An inventory_add result may not appear in the top resource bar immediately.

mobs.building.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.building.steps: Select exactly ONE owned building, reopen the console, then inspect it. inventory optionally filters goods by name or ID.
mobs.building.notes: Building inventory is local storage, not the total regional stock. An inventory_add result may not appear in the top resource bar immediately.

mobs.stock.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.stock.steps: Read the target region stock, optionally filtering by item name or ID.
mobs.stock.notes: The native regional stock query can include reserved goods. It differs from a selected building inventory. Read-only.

mobs.clear_empty_piles.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.clear_empty_piles.steps: Preview the count, then run without preview to remove only confirmed-empty owned Supplies piles in the target region.
mobs.clear_empty_piles.notes: Non-empty and unreadable piles are retained. Other regions and buildings are untouched. Removal has no undo.

mobs.remove_selected_piles.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.remove_selected_piles.steps: Select the bugged Supplies pile(s), preview, then remove preview to delete those selected piles.
mobs.remove_selected_piles.notes: Deletes CONTENTS as well as the pile, including unfinished/bugged piles. It ignores the region pin and rejects foreign targets. There is no undo.

mobs.cancel.target: Any pending one-shot click tool or queued forestry batch.
mobs.cancel.steps: Run before switching click tools or when you no longer want to place/deliver anything.
mobs.cancel.notes: Stops future clicks/batches only. Completed placements, deliveries and growth are retained. It is not undo.

mobs.finish_constructions.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.finish_constructions.steps: Preview unfinished sites, run without preview, then resume simulation. Watch sites finalize; workers may still need to reach them.
mobs.finish_constructions.notes: Prepares native construction work and supplies missing materials. It does not forcibly replace actors or guarantee instant simulation finalization. No undo; inspect failures in the result.

mobs.construction_needs.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.construction_needs.steps: Select one construction site for a detailed bill, or request region totals without a building selection.
mobs.construction_needs.notes: Required, stored and incoming goods are counted separately. Missing amounts include incoming deliveries to avoid oversupply. Read-only.

mobs.supply_construction.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin. Use selected explicitly to operate on selected owned sites instead.
mobs.supply_construction.steps: Preview first. The default supplies missing materials across the target region; selected limits it to selected unfinished/upgrading buildings.
mobs.supply_construction.notes: Supplies materials only; it does not finish work. All selected targets must be valid sites. No undo.

mobs.construction.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.construction.steps: Use pause or resume to change unfinished sites throughout the target region.
mobs.construction.notes: This affects the sites construction state, not the global simulation speed. It does not fill materials or finish work.

mobs.instant_build.target: Global native setting for this session, affecting newly placed buildings.
mobs.instant_build.steps: Read status, switch on, place the intended new building, then switch off when finished.
mobs.instant_build.notes: Applies globally until disabled, not just in a pinned region. Existing unfinished sites use finish_constructions instead. A restart resets session-only behavior.

mobs.demolish.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.demolish.steps: Select owned buildings, preview the targets, then run without preview to request the native demolition with normal refunds.
mobs.demolish.notes: Maximum 32 targets. All must be eligible before the first demolition. No undo; already completed demolitions remain if a later target changes.

mobs.resources.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.resources.steps: Inspect existing clumps with resources. Refill returns matching existing clumps to capacity; empty sets matching amounts to zero while retaining actors. Preview either mutation first.
mobs.resources.notes: Kinds: iron, clay, salt, stone, berries, mushrooms, fish, eel; wildlife excluded. Does not create nodes or fill storehouses. Existing underground reserves use deposit. Empty seasonal resources may later regrow under game rules.

mobs.refill_resources.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.refill_resources.steps: Inspect existing clumps with resources. Refill returns matching existing clumps to capacity; empty sets matching amounts to zero while retaining actors. Preview either mutation first.
mobs.refill_resources.notes: Kinds: iron, clay, salt, stone, berries, mushrooms, fish, eel; wildlife excluded. Does not create nodes or fill storehouses. Existing underground reserves use deposit. Empty seasonal resources may later regrow under game rules.

mobs.empty_resources.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.empty_resources.steps: Inspect existing clumps with resources. Refill returns matching existing clumps to capacity; empty sets matching amounts to zero while retaining actors. Preview either mutation first.
mobs.empty_resources.notes: Kinds: iron, clay, salt, stone, berries, mushrooms, fish, eel; wildlife excluded. Does not create nodes or fill storehouses. Existing underground reserves use deposit. Empty seasonal resources may later regrow under game rules.

mobs.undo_resources.target: Latest unchanged resource refill/empty batch in this session.
mobs.undo_resources.steps: Run after a refill/empty batch to restore its previous clump amounts.
mobs.undo_resources.notes: Up to five batches retained. If harvesting or another edit changed any target, undo refuses to overwrite it. It cannot undo spawning/removal.

mobs.spawn_resource.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.spawn_resource.steps: Choose a supported kind. Optionally give amount PER clump and a clump count, then rich. Preview uses the same click workflow; run again without preview to place.
mobs.spawn_resource.notes: Kinds: iron, clay, salt, stone, berries, mushrooms, fish, eel. Count 1..64; amount 1..1000000 per clump. Fish/eel need suitable reachable water. The 0.16 alpha preserves native aquatic identity/seasonality and adds region availability tags; harvesting and save/load still need testing. Use repair_fishing for existing shoals. Deer/hares use spawn_wildlife instead. No undo.

mobs.resource.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.resource.steps: Choose an action, kind and an amount only for add. Click near the actual clump/node within 2500 game units. Preview each placement/removal/edit before applying.
mobs.resource.notes: remove deletes a whole surface group; remove_clump only one clump. Exact kind is required: fish and eel differ. refresh repairs land clump size/height/visibility, not amounts. Real underground reserves use remove_deposit; empty clumpless non-wildlife nodes are removable here. No undo.

mobs.refresh_resource_icons.target: Current game HUD; no click or building selection.
mobs.refresh_resource_icons.steps: Run preview to compare authoritative/displayed node counts, then run normally. Let the HUD tick and reopen the map if needed.
mobs.refresh_resource_icons.notes: Repairs the separate normal-map icon/paper-map hover list after spawned/removed resources. It does not create clumps, alter amounts, resolve worker reachability or repair old underground orientation.

mobs.spawn_deposit.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.spawn_deposit.steps: Choose iron, clay or salt, a quantity, and optional rich. Preview, then place clear owned ground. New versions create a finite surface clump AND a separate underground reserve with that quantity.
mobs.spawn_deposit.notes: 1000 means 1000 surface units plus 1000 underground units. Rich reserves follow the native deep-mining rules and can be displayed as endless; the surface clump supplies the finite tooltip amount. Old empty markers need removal/recreation. No undo.

mobs.remove_deposit.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.remove_deposit.steps: Choose iron, clay, salt or all, close the console and click near the underground reserve. Preview first.
mobs.remove_deposit.notes: Removes underground reserves/decal and colocated empty legacy markers. Real surface clumps remain deliberately: remove them separately using resource remove. all means nearest matching kind, not every deposit on the map. No undo.

mobs.deposit.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.deposit.steps: Use add to increase an EXISTING underground reserve, or rich/normal to change its flag. Click within 2500 of the reserve.
mobs.deposit.notes: Cannot edit a surface-only resource group. A visible icon alone does not prove an underground reserve exists. Use resource add for surface ore; spawn_deposit creates both layers in new versions.

mobs.undo_deposit.target: Latest unchanged underground reserve edit in this session.
mobs.undo_deposit.steps: Undo an add/rich/normal edit after confirming no extraction or later edit changed the target.
mobs.undo_deposit.notes: Ten edits retained until player/mod reload. Does not undo creation/removal or rebuild a deleted deposit.

mobs.pond.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.pond.steps: place starts the native Fishing Pond building tool. Close the console and place it. Let construction finish. remove arms an owned pond-removal click, with preview support.
mobs.pond.notes: A pond is a building, not a fish shoal. Creating one does not automatically prove fish are present. Use pond_fish on a completed pond. Removal has no undo.

mobs.pond_fish.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.pond_fish.steps: Finish the Fishing Pond first. Run the command, close the console and click close to that pond (within 1500 game units).
mobs.pond_fish.notes: Adds one shoal to the nearest completed owned Fishing Pond. Existing shoals are rejected to prevent duplicates; refill existing fish instead. Worker harvesting and save/load need live confirmation. No undo.

mobs.grow_trees.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.grow_trees.steps: Preview the eligible world-tree records, run normally, and wait for the completion notification. Work runs in bounded batches.
mobs.grow_trees.notes: Grows native young and intermediate world-tree stages to maturity, including previously untracked stages; decorative bushes are excluded. Blocked transitions are reported rather than counted as successful. Does not plant an entire new forest. No undo.

mobs.grow_saplings.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin. For area, select ONE owned building with an explicitly limited work area.
mobs.grow_saplings.steps: Preview first. grow_saplings matures registered plantings, including forester saplings. grow_stage advances each eligible record one native stage instead of fully maturing it.
mobs.grow_saplings.notes: The area scope uses the selected building work circle, not the camera viewport. Native transitions can be blocked. Completion may run in batches; cancel stops future batches only. No undo.

mobs.grow_stage.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin. For area, select ONE owned building with an explicitly limited work area.
mobs.grow_stage.steps: Preview first. grow_saplings matures registered plantings, including forester saplings. grow_stage advances each eligible record one native stage instead of fully maturing it.
mobs.grow_stage.notes: The area scope uses the selected building work circle, not the camera viewport. Native transitions can be blocked. Completion may run in batches; cancel stops future batches only. No undo.

mobs.replant_trees.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing. The command-target region must also match the intended owned ground.
mobs.replant_trees.steps: replant_trees places ONE oak sapling on cleared ground. regrow_trees combines that single replant click with maturation of eligible native trees in the target region.
mobs.replant_trees.notes: This is one sapling per click, not a forest brush. Native collision checks still apply. Existing saplings and world trees can instead be matured without planting by grow_saplings/grow_trees. No undo.

mobs.regrow_trees.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing. The command-target region must also match the intended owned ground.
mobs.regrow_trees.steps: replant_trees places ONE oak sapling on cleared ground. regrow_trees combines that single replant click with maturation of eligible native trees in the target region.
mobs.regrow_trees.notes: This is one sapling per click, not a forest brush. Native collision checks still apply. Existing saplings and world trees can instead be matured without planting by grow_saplings/grow_trees. No undo.

mobs.fertility.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch. fertilization region explicitly uses the owned command-target region instead.
mobs.fertility.steps: fertility reads existing crop fertility and fertilization counters. fertilization toggles permission, with selected/region scope and optional preview.
mobs.fertility.notes: Permission does not add soil fertility or bypass game prerequisites. Use soil for actual grid edits. Rye and oats are included in fertility inspection.

mobs.fertilization.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch. fertilization region explicitly uses the owned command-target region instead.
mobs.fertilization.steps: fertility reads existing crop fertility and fertilization counters. fertilization toggles permission, with selected/region scope and optional preview.
mobs.fertilization.notes: Permission does not add soil fertility or bypass game prerequisites. Use soil for actual grid edits. Rye and oats are included in fertility inspection.

mobs.undo_fertilization.steps: Run after a permission toggle to restore previous permissions.
mobs.undo_fertilization.notes: Five batches retained until reload. Changed ownership or permission values cause refusal. This does not restore soil fertility.

mobs.soil.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.soil.steps: For selected scope, select planted fields/plots. For area, set an explicit limited work area on each selected owned building. set takes a percentage; restore has no percentage argument. Preview first.
mobs.soil.notes: set changes baseline AND current fertility. restore removes depletion up to existing baseline, so it does not make poor baseline soil perfect. Rye shares wheat soil; oats share barley. Unplanted plots can select zero cells: use plants to inspect or a limited work area. Overlay may refresh later.

mobs.plants.target: Select the owned building in the normal game view BEFORE opening the console. A pinned region does not select buildings. Up to 32 buildings only where the command explicitly allows a batch.
mobs.plants.steps: Select planted fields or a forestry building, then inspect plant records.
mobs.plants.notes: Read-only: prints counts and up to 100 records with type, position, growth, yield and soil-cell index. It does not plant, harvest or change fertility.

mobs.undo_soil.target: Latest unchanged soil batch in the same loaded settlement.
mobs.undo_soil.steps: Preview the restoration, then run without preview.
mobs.undo_soil.notes: Refuses if edited values or ownership changed, rather than overwriting newer simulation changes. Only the latest native soil batch is retained.

mobs.perks.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.perks.steps: Open Development once to load the card table, then list/search cards. Use the displayed number or a unique key with add/remove; clear removes extras.
mobs.perks.notes: Cards are regional Origins/Rural Foundations, not development-tree points. Extras include penalties; shared effects apply once. The vanilla screen shows primary cards only. Numbers refer to this listing, not item IDs.

mobs.perk_add.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.perk_add.steps: List cards, then add a listed number or unique key. Preview first. mobs.perks add is the friendlier equivalent.
mobs.perk_add.notes: Keeps primary cards and applies an extra regional card including its penalties. Primary cards cannot be added twice. Preserve Native/State when upgrading. Full save/load behavior needs continued confirmation.

mobs.perks_add.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.perks_add.steps: List cards, then add a listed number or unique key. Preview first. mobs.perks add is the friendlier equivalent.
mobs.perks_add.notes: Keeps primary cards and applies an extra regional card including its penalties. Primary cards cannot be added twice. Preserve Native/State when upgrading. Full save/load behavior needs continued confirmation.

mobs.perk_remove.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.perk_remove.steps: Remove an extra card by its listed number or unique key. Preview checks the plan before rebuilding effects.
mobs.perk_remove.notes: Preserves primary cards and effects supplied by other active cards. This is the companion reversal for an added extra; respec handles primary choices.

mobs.perks_remove.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.

mobs.perk_clear.notes: Includes all extras in this region only. Effects are rebuilt from the retained primaries; perks_clear is an alias.

mobs.perk_points.steps: perk_points restores a tier choice by resetting that tier. respec_perks clears the specified primary choice(s) and rebuilds effects; default is both. Preview first.
mobs.perk_points.notes: Not a numeric currency editor and not development-tree points. Resetting tier 1 ALSO resets tier 2 because of the dependency. Settlement unlock gates remain.

mobs.grow_population.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.grow_population.steps: Run status to inspect approval, the game natural monthly growth result, usable housing places and homeless families. Preview the requested 1..10 PEOPLE, then run without preview to create them now through the native resident/family/home path. Existing incomplete eligible families are filled first; new families use vacant completed housing. No click is needed.
mobs.grow_population.notes: 0.16.0-alpha.3 changes the number from repeated growth attempts to actual people, not families. Default 1; maximum 10 per call. Explicit creation bypasses the natural approval/arrival-day gates without changing the date or forcing approval. All planned home entrances are preflighted before creation; enough housing is required for the whole request. Sleeping/unfinished/mourning homes are excluded. Existing homeless families take priority over new households. Native failures stop and report actual population change without retrying or rolling back earlier arrivals. New population has ordinary needs and can later leave under normal game rules. Live/save-load confirmation remains pending. No undo.

mobs.skip_mourning.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.skip_mourning.steps: Preview buildings with active mourning timers, then run normally to clear them.
mobs.skip_mourning.notes: This clears timers in the target region. It does not revive deceased residents or add a family. No undo.

mobs.livestock_cooldown.target: Your owned command-target region. Run mobs.regions, then mobs.region with a listed ID; confirm mobs.status. mobs.region auto clears the pin.
mobs.livestock_cooldown.steps: Run without arguments to inspect the next livestock-order cooldown; reset clears that cooldown.
mobs.livestock_cooldown.notes: Does not order, spawn or deliver animals, and does not fill a trading post inventory.

mobs.animal.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.animal.steps: Choose ox, horse, mule, sheep, lamb, goat, pig, chicken, hound, cow, calf, deer or hare; optionally 1..20 animals and preview.
mobs.animal.notes: These are individual native spawned animals. deer/hare here do NOT create a registered hunting resource node; a hunting icon/working herd is not implemented. Do not use item IDs. No undo.

mobs.unit.target: Hover the intended living owned unit; follow it before opening the console if hover is lost. rehouse also needs one selected owned completed house.
mobs.unit.steps: unit inspects; rename_unit accepts a multiword name; undo_unit_name restores a guarded rename. follow tracks the camera; off stops it. rehouse selected moves the hovered/followed family after capacity checks.
mobs.unit.notes: Renaming requires an owned home. Rehousing stays in the same region and checks housing capacity; no undo for family moves. Follow can normalize game speed. A region pin does not select a unit.

mobs.teleport.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing. unit uses your hovered/followed owned unit; squads uses selected owned squads.
mobs.teleport.steps: Select/follow the targets first, run unit or squads with preview, then close the console and click the destination.
mobs.teleport.notes: Formation offsets are preserved for squads. Existing orders remain active, so units may move again immediately. No undo.

mobs.claim.target: Explicit map selection or a real region ID from mobs.map_regions.
mobs.claim.steps: Start a claim without influence cost, or finish a claim already belonging to your lord. Preview before applying; all is supported for existing claims when appropriate.
mobs.claim.notes: Not the same as choosing the command-target region. Finish requires a valid existing claim; it does not simply grant arbitrary foreign land. No undo.

mobs.mercenaries.steps: Use the literal reroll subcommand, then reopen the hiring panel.
mobs.mercenaries.notes: Changes offers through the game; does not hire or pay units. No undo.

mobs.bandits.steps: Preview, then request a camp at a valid random game-chosen location.
mobs.bandits.notes: This asks the game to choose a valid site; it does not place a camp at your mouse click. No undo.

mobs.bandit_camp.target: Clear UNCLAIMED ground, away from building borders.
mobs.bandit_camp.steps: Run with preview, close the console and click clear unclaimed ground. Repeat without preview to request a real camp squad/order, then resume simulation.
mobs.bandit_camp.notes: Owned or foreign-claimed ground is rejected. This is hostile content, not your own settlement troops. No undo.

mobs.raiders.target: A playable clicked region; this tool can create hostile squads.
mobs.raiders.steps: Choose 1..6 squads, preview, close the console and click the region.
mobs.raiders.notes: Creates hostile raiders rather than recruiting your militia. No undo.

mobs.weather.steps: Choose rain, drought, clear, end_rain or end_drought. instant requests immediate transition; damaging applies only to rain. Preview first.
mobs.weather.notes: The simulation can later choose new weather. clear ends rain and drought; end_rain/end_drought affect the chosen condition. No undo.

mobs.speed.steps: Run without arguments to read speed, or choose 0..12. Zero pauses and one resumes normally.
mobs.speed.notes: Uses the native speed request. High speed may alter performance and make changes harder to observe. This does not advance an exact number of days.

mobs.skip_day.steps: Preview a count from 1..30, then request native day updates if intended.
mobs.skip_day.notes: Daily simulation events may run. It is not a guarantee that workers finish travel/jobs or that population appears. No undo.

mobs.boop.steps: Read status or explicitly turn the setting on/off. With no argument the current mode toggles.
mobs.boop.notes: This exposes the native debug Boop setting, not a documented task-assignment API. Use only when you want that native mode; not required for normal commands.

mobs.foreign_supply.steps: Read all entries or filter by display name/item ID.
mobs.foreign_supply.notes: Read-only global market information; not stock in your target region and not a delivery.

mobs.run.target: Local text files inside this mod Commands folder.
mobs.run.steps: Write one exact Mobs command per line in a .txt file. Preview displays the commands; remove preview to run them in order.
mobs.run.notes: Only up to 100 lines/64 KiB. No scripts, path traversal or recursive run. Stops at first error; prior successful mutations remain. Do not put several click placements in one file: each arms a pending tool rather than completing a click.

help.target: Read-only discovery; no settlement required unless loaded game data is being requested.
help.steps: Open the console and browse the dashboard or searchable help. Copy exact command syntax; replace placeholders and omit brackets.
help.notes: help is an alias for mobs.help. mobs uses exact command matching when dispatching actions; typo matches only suggest.

mobs.spawn_wildlife.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.spawn_wildlife.steps: Choose deer or hare, optionally rich, and preview first. Close the console and click clear ground in an owned region. The resource node and herd home are placed at that click; animals are distributed nearby. All planned animal sites are checked for valid native height, the same region and native blockers before any squad or animal is created. Repeat without preview and click the same spot to apply. Include the site in a staffed hunting camp work area and resume simulation.
mobs.spawn_wildlife.notes: 0.16 alpha; actual hunting and save/reload await user testing. Population is the midpoint of the game normal/rich population range (bounded to 1..256), so preview and apply agree. Animals begin within 1000 game units of the clicked node and can wander under normal game AI. Blocked or border-crossing placements are refused before spawning. One herd per applied click. Existing mobs.animal deer/hare remains individual spawning. No undo; do not repeat placement if registration reports an incomplete result.

mobs.repair_fishing.target: Run the command, close the console, then click the intended location in an owned region. It is a one-shot tool with a five-minute expiry. mobs.cancel disarms it. Preview also requires the click, but changes nothing.
mobs.repair_fishing.steps: Default kind is eel. Run preview, close the console and click near the actual shoal, within 2500 game units. Read the planned identity, regional registration and availability-tag counts. Repeat without preview and click the SAME shoal. Resume simulation; ensure a staffed fishing workplace has access to appropriate water. Check actual catches, then save separately and reload.
mobs.repair_fishing.notes: Candidate repair for existing eel/fish nodes; worker harvesting and persistence are not yet verified. Restores the live game template identity/seasonal flag, native placement height, region resource registration, availability tag and map view/HUD. Amounts, capacity and richness remain unchanged. Rejects unavailable template defaults, other resource kinds and building-attached pond fish. Fish and eel never substitute for each other. Does not create a missing/deleted shoal, fix every shoreline/reachability problem, or undo earlier depletion. No undo.
